symptom: Switching conversations or configuring a model while the window closes can leave an invisible live lane holding its JSONL session; concurrent create/delete commands fail against an open session.
direct_cause: configureModel and lane commands independently close/open the mutable active handle. close neither marks the workspace closed nor waits for a pending opener, so the late handle escapes cleanup.
class_root: The workspace lacks one admission and ownership boundary for structural changes and closure.
affected_population: Concurrent model configuration and conversation switching
Duplicate creation and deletion while a new lane is opening
internal_only_reason: Nomi owns the workspace lifecycle above pi. Existing pi session exclusivity is used unchanged and the real JSONL fixture exposes orphan ownership; no upstream behavior or protocol is changed.
invariants: At most one structural operation may replace or delete the active workspace resources at a time.
Once close is called no new operation is admitted and every late opened handle is closed before close resolves.
A running prompt never holds approvals or abort behind its model/tool turn.
generality_proof: Every configure/create/select/delete shares the workspace structural queue; closure synchronously shuts admission before draining that queue. Direct commands never join the queue and cannot target a changing or closed handle.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own admission, serialization and final disposal of every workspace lane handle.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Input preparation can replace the configured host while a separate lane-create/select/delete IPC request arrives.
Window destruction and workspace-close call workspace.close while an earlier host replacement is in flight.

recurrence.reason: Any repeated UI input or window close may interleave at each asynchronous host close/open boundary.
same_class_scan: rg configureModel electron/agentLane tests/agent-runtime identifies IPC configuration and history-resume callers.
rg workspace.execute and workspace.close electron/agentLane/laneIpc.ts identifies structure commands, window destruction and registration disposal.

prevention.invariant: Structure changes serialize and close synchronously denies admission before draining and disposing all opened handles.
prevention.failure_mode: Closed or changing workspaces reject direct commands immediately; a failed replacement permanently closes that workspace rather than reusing an already closed handle.
prevention.strategy: Queue only structural work; guard late open results and use an immediate closed flag. Leave live prompt/approval/abort dispatch outside the queue.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace independent structural mutations and asynchronous-only close in their existing owner; no parallel lock or fallback remains.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: This fixes Nomi workspace ownership above the existing pi lane close and session exclusivity APIs without changing dependency behavior.

migration: No persisted format or session identity changes; existing lanes open through the same pi session repository.
residual_risks: IPC sender identity and input preparation are separately owned and verified by the cutover IPC change.

invariant_owner_layer.why: Only the workspace can coordinate active-handle replacement across model configuration, conversation commands and closure.
